description: Fully opaque floor-length burgundy court tunic with long sleeves and gold geometric embroidery at the round neck, front opening, cuffs and hem; cream inner tunic visible at neck, cuffs and hem; ornate gold-brown belt at the natural waist; dark purple long draped shoulder cloak fastened by a round brooch with patterned gold edging and fringe; brown trousers and complete brown leather boots. Both hands clasp in front, face uncovered, full body visible against plain stone columns and a dark wooden doorway, with no heraldic wall banner.
